caption: The video captures a soldier in camouflage uniform and helmet lying prone in tall, dry grass, shouldering a scoped rifle whose objective lens cap is flipped open. The rifle points toward the right of the frame, and the out-of-focus foreground blades sway continuously in the wind, partially veiling the shooter and the weapon. The soldier maintains a steady aiming posture throughout, with only minor adjustments of the head and body against the stock. A slow drift of the subject and the blurred background trees shifts the framing gradually toward the right side of the view. The raised scope cap stays flipped open but its angle relative to the optic shifts visibly at several points. No recoil, muzzle flash, or smoke appears, so no shot is visibly fired during this segment. The bright, overexposed sky and indistinct foliage remain behind the prone figure.
